entry: Select the GitHub Copilot session target and factory custom agent, then invoke /factory-build, /factory-blueprint, /factory-resume or /factory-status. The underlying factory-start workflow remains available.

sources.requirement: Agents use .github/agents/*.agent.md. An agents allowlist must include the agent tool. Handoffs are user interactions rather than durable orchestration.

VS Code can discover .github, .claude and .agents skill folders; export only one factory skill library per workspace. Entry skills use argument-hint and user-invocable for slash commands; they do not select the custom agent automatically.
Use documented read, search, edit, execute, web and agent tool sets. Actual availability depends on the selected harness and extensions.
Hook schema and behavior depend on the session target; no portable hook enforcement is assumed. The VS Code Local harness also loads repository .github/hooks/*.json files for every agent.

Copilot CLI and cloud agent load repository .github/hooks/*.json. preToolUse input (sessionId, timestamp, cwd, toolName, toolArgs) carries no agent identity, so a repository hook cannot restrict only the orchestrator.
A Claude model selected inside Copilot still uses the Copilot harness. Test file discovery and observed behavior separately.
Discover models for the actual account/client/harness. Validate constraints and record requested versus observed selection separately.

limits: Supported environment: VS Code Local (the local agent session). The agents allowlist on the factory agent is a VS Code Local feature; Copilot CLI and the cloud agent do not apply it, and copilot-instructions.md says missions are unsupported there.

The factory agent has read, search, execute and agent tool sets (no web, no edit); specialists set include-custom-instructions: true so AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md reach them, and factory.agent.md carries the constitution preamble.
Specialists disable nested delegation; the factory main agent delegates named specialists.
Planner and reviewer omit execution and edit tool sets; confirm enforcement in the selected runtime.

The factory orchestrator agent omits the edit tool set; it keeps execute, so avoiding shell writes is instruction-only. No model pin, hooks, terminal auto-approval or additional extension permissions are generated.

Copilot hooks are not exported: preToolUse input has no agent identity and repository hooks apply to every agent (VS Code also loads them), so an orchestrator guard would also block implementers. Future work: VS Code Local supports agent-scoped hooks in a custom agent file, which could carry an orchestrator-only guard there.
Copilot CLI is unsupported but still auto-discovers AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/agents, .claude/agents and all skill trees; the cloud agent does not list the agents key.

With claude and copilot active, Copilot CLI or VS Code with chat.useClaudeMdFile can load AGENTS.md directly and again through the CLAUDE.md @AGENTS.md import; the files differ and are not de-duplicated.
factory-models provides constrained model planning; requested selection is not proof of the model actually used. No global model settings are rewritten.

model_selection.inventory: actual host/picker inventory; user reports retain provenance
model_selection.application: host session picker or supported native subagent control; dispatch report does not apply settings
model_selection.effective_identity: runtime evidence when exposed; otherwise unknown
